metadata.title: SR sector 06
metadata.description: Storage-ring sector 06 of the demo facility: straight 06 and its arc in beam order with every magnet, corrector and BPM of the records, the straight's own devices, the vacuum (ion pumps, gauges, gate valves), insertion devices, front-end shutters, absorber temperatures, scrapers and the tunnel environment, with their status and readbacks, and the orbit at the arc's BPMs as X and Y bars.
